info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Utility Billing Estimates-v2-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Estimates Retrieval API provides access to utility billing estimates, enabling users to efficiently retrieve relevant financial data. This endpoint is primarily designed for utility companies and developers seeking to integrate billing estimates into their applications or systems. Typical use cases include generating reports, analyzing billing trends, and ensuring accurate customer communications. With this API, businesses can streamline their billing processes and provide better insights to their customers.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a detailed billing estimate based on the provided parameters. It helps users understand their potential charges before finalizing any transactions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve billing estimates. It contains parameters necessary for the estimation process.

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the billing estimate.

state.description: The current state of the billing estimate.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

audit.description: Details about the audit trail for the billing estimate operation.
